title: Mix dry ingredients
description: In a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, combine King Arthur gluten-free bread flour (680 g), sugar (65 g), instant yeast (2.25 tsp), salt (2 tsp), and baking powder (1 tsp) until evenly mixed.

title: Add liquids and knead in mixer
description: With the mixer on low, slowly add water (295 ml), whole milk (236 ml), eggs (2), and melted butter (6 tbsp), then turn to medium and mix 3 minutes until very smooth (thick cookie dough).

title: Scrape bowl
description: Scrape the bottom and sides of the bowl with a spatula lightly coated with neutral oil.

title: Refrigerate dough
description: Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate so the dough is easier to roll.

title: Cinnamon sugar and grease pan
description: Mix brown sugar (0.33 cup) and cinnamon (2 tbsp) in a small bowl, then lightly grease a 9×13-inch baking dish with butter or cooking spray.

title: Roll, fill, cut, and pan rolls
description: Turn dough onto a surface dusted with gluten-free flour, shape into a ball, and roll to a 15×15-inch square. Spread melted butter (8 tbsp) over the dough, sprinkle with the cinnamon-sugar, cut twelve 1.25-inch strips with a pizza cutter, roll each strip, and place in the dish.

title: Proof until doubled
description: Cover pan with plastic wrap or a towel. Rest in a warm spot 45–60 minutes until about doubled.

title: Preheat oven to 350°F
description: Preheat while the rolls finish rising.

title: Bake rolls
description: Bake at 350°F until slightly golden brown, about 30–35 minutes.

title: Cool slightly
description: Rest until just slightly warm to the touch before frosting.

title: Beat frosting
description: Beat cream cheese (8 oz) until smooth, then beat in butter (4 tbsp), powdered sugar (0.33 cup), and vanilla extract (2 tsp) until combined.

title: Ice and serve
description: Spread frosting over the warm rolls with a knife or spatula. Serve immediately.
